chapter.heading: Prayer for Israel’s RestorationTo the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A Testimony of Asaph. A Psalm.
chapter.v:
Give ear,
O Shepherd of Israel,You who lead Joseph like a flock;You who dwell between the cherubim, shine forth! [Ps. 45:1]

Before Ephraim,
Benjamin, and Manasseh,Stir up Your strength,And come and save us! [Is. 4:6 1 shelter]

Restore us,
O God;Cause Your face to shine,And we shall be saved! [Is. 29:18; 35:5 the Egyptians and defending Israel (Ex. 12:13, 23). Jesus Christ (7:14; 9:1–7; 11:1–5; 28:16; John 10:11, 16). The princ- es are His undershepherds (1 Pet. 5:2–4).]

O Lord
God of hosts,How long will You be angryAgainst the prayer of Your people? [Is. 29:24]

You have
fed them with the bread of tears,And given them tears to drink in great measure.

You have
made us a strife to our neighbors,And our enemies laugh among themselves. [Prov. 24:7-9]

Restore us,
O God of hosts;Cause Your face to shine,And we shall be saved! [Jer. 5:26-28; Mic. 7:3]

You have
brought a vine out of Egypt;You have cast out the nations, and planted it.

You prepared
room for it,And caused it to take deep root,And it filled the land. [Is. 47:8; Amos 6:1; Zeph. 2:15]

The hills
were covered with its shadow,And the mighty cedars with its boughs.

She sent
out her boughs to the Sea,And her branches to the River.

Why have
You broken down her hedges,So that all who pass by the way pluck her fruit?

The boar
out of the woods uproots it,And the wild beast of the field devours it. [Is. 7:23-25; Hos. 9:6 i Is. 22:2]

Return, we
beseech You, O God of hosts;Look down from heaven and see,And visit this vine [Is. 27:10]

And the
vineyard which Your right hand has planted,And the branch that You made strong for Yourself. [[Is. 11:2]; Ezek. 39:29; [Joel 2:28] l Ps. 107:35; Is. 29:17]

It is
burned with fire, it is cut down;They perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.

Let Your
hand be upon the man of Your right hand,Upon the son of man whom You made strong for Yourself. [Ps. 119:165; Is. 2:4; Rom. 14:17; James 3:18]

Then we
will not turn back from You;Revive us, and we will call upon Your name. [Is. 11:10; 14:3; 30:15; [Hos. 2:18-23; Zech. 2:5;]

Restore us,
O Lord God of hosts;Cause Your face to shine,And we shall be saved! [Is. 30:30] [Zech. 11:2]
